support_for_judgement: D1: 'randomly allocated ... using computer generated random numbers' but concealment method not described; registered retrospectively (CTRI/2012/04/002570). D2: open-label, no analysis-population statement, feasibility design. D4: subjective outcomes (feed intolerance, discharge timing) assessed by unmasked clinicians. D5: no protocol/registry outcome list available for comparison.

D1: randomisation with allocation concealment described; UMIN000004225. D2: unmasked clinicians and caregivers; discharge decisions by unmasked team. D3: no post-randomisation exclusions reported (36/36 analysed). D4: primary outcome (length of stay) determined by unmasked clinicians. D5: registered but outcome list not verifiable in text.

D1: randomisation stated; concealment not described; no registration identified. D2: open-label; no ITT statement. D3: 103 randomised but analyses report differing denominators and the weight analysis retains only infants without post-randomisation exclusion for intolerance/instability/PDA. D4: unmasked assessment of feed intolerance. D5: no registration.

D1: computer-generated block randomisation with sequentially numbered opaque sealed envelopes; NCT02187978 prospectively registered. D2: masking of clinicians infeasible (running intravenous fluids reveal allocation); no ITT population statement for all outcomes. D3: 91/89 analysed of 91/89 randomised. D4: NEC radiographs adjudicated by a masked radiologist; feed intolerance unmasked. D5: registry outcomes match report.

D1: computer-generated randomisation with opaque sealed envelopes. D2: open-label with no masking of any party. D3: outborn cohort with deaths during admission; analysis population not explicitly defined. D4: subjective outcomes unmasked; sepsis reported as a composite of clinical, screen-positive and culture-positive categories in a single cell. D5: no registration identified.

D1: 'randomization sequence discovered by opening the sealed cover' — sequence generation method not described. D2: open-label, no masking. D3: two post-randomisation exclusions for genetic anomalies and two intervention-arm infants who never received the intervention, died of underlying disease and were excluded from analysis, so mortality reporting is incomplete. D4: unmasked assessment of all subjective outcomes. D5: no registration; outcomes reported selectively (mixed mean/SD and median/IQR rows).

D1: randomisation with allocation concealment; NCT04337710 prospectively registered. D2: unmasked intervention but pragmatic protocol with clear feeding rules. D3: 48/51 and 49/51 analysed; reasons for attrition given. D4: primary outcome (full enteral feeding days) is chart-derived and objective; discharge anthropometry rows carry interval-shaped values under mean (SD) labels, an internal reporting inconsistency. D5: registry outcomes correspond to report.

D1: block randomisation (blocks of 2 and 4) with serially numbered opaque sealed envelopes; CTRI/2021/03/031643 with ethics approval IEC/93/20. D2: intention-to-treat analysis stated; masking of clinicians infeasible but data analyst unaware of allocation. D3: 29/31 and 27/31 analysed with reasons; twins randomised as independent infants. D4: outcome assessor masked to allocation. D5: prospectively registered with matching outcome list.

D1: computer-generated randomisation, stratified, with concealment; NCT03708068. D2: open-label; COVID-19 pandemic disrupted recruitment and some infants received brief parenteral nutrition before enrolment. D3: 35/35 analysed in both arms. D4: primary outcome objective (time to full feeds from charts). D5: registered outcomes match; NEC/SIP absence reported narratively rather than tabulated.

D1: web-based minimisation algorithm with allocation within 3 h of birth; ISRCTN89654042 prospectively registered with published protocol and statistical analysis plan. D2: parents and clinical team could not be masked, but investigators and data analysts were masked until database lock; intention-to-treat analysis in allocated group. D3: primary outcome data missing for 36 (1.7%) of 2088, below the 2% allowed in the sample size calculation. D4: length of stay is objective and a second objective-discharge-criteria outcome was pre-specified to mitigate variation in discharge practice. D5: pre-specified analysis plan published before database lock.

D1: sequence generated by an external faculty member with tamper-evident opaque sealed envelopes prepared by staff uninvolved in the trial. D2: open-label; the trial's own discussion concedes baseline imbalances favouring the intervention arm in birth weight, gestation, growth restriction and need for resuscitation that are prognostically important though not statistically significant. D3: analysis denominators not fully reconciled with randomised numbers. D4: NEC adjudication procedure not described. D5: no registration identified in the text.

D1: computer-generated block randomisation with sequentially numbered opaque sealed envelopes; CTRI/2022/09/045974 with ethics approval LHMC/IEC/2021/03/68. D2: masking infeasible but intention-to-treat analysis with a pre-specified analysis plan; both arms received donor human milk and probiotics, standardising co-interventions. D3: 87/83 analysed with mortality reported for all. D4: pre-specified objective outcome definitions (full feeds 150 mL/kg/day sustained 48 h; Bell stage 2/3). D5: prospectively registered with matching outcomes.
